raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "0.7.5"
  build_number: 3

package:
  name: pyne
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/pyne/pyne/archive/${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 80143d5e232b89ffd89121363c0e1e615acc28c26f5d7682521eb9baf98311c4
  patches:
    - drop-distutils-from-setup-py.patch
    - use-shutil-rmtree-in-utils.patch
    - use-policy_max-in-cmake_minimum_required.patch
    - use-python3-cmake-variables.patch
    - ignore-unknown-arguments-passed-to-setup.patch
    - use-fallow-argument-mismatch-for-fortran.patch
    - update-to-cython3.patch
    - use-setuptools-for-setup_sub.py.patch
    - ensure-meson-backend-for-f2py.patch
    - fix-add-missing-commas-for-fortran-runtime.patch
    - use-importlib-in-tests.patch
    - python310-collections-ordereddict.patch
    - cython3-test-strict-utf8.patch
    - numpy2-compat.patch
    - use-scipy-integrate-trapezoid.patch
    # Drop after pyne v0.7.7
    # c.f. https://github.com/pyne/pyne/pull/1502
    - use-std-isnan-instead-of-macro.patch
    # c.f. https://github.com/pyne/pyne/pull/1585
    # NOTE: Will need to update beyond v0.7.5
    - reproducible-builds-pyne-data.patch

build:
  number: ${{ build_number }}
  string: ${{ enable_moab }}_${{ enable_openmc }}py${{ python | version_to_buildstring }}h${{ hash }}_${{ build_number }}
  skip:
    - win
    # FIXME: Need linux-aarch64 and osx-arm64 builds for openmc
    # c.f. https://github.com/conda-forge/openmc-feedstock/issues/87
    - enable_openmc == "openmc" and not x86_64
    # FIXME: No Python 3.14 builds of openmc exist yet (openmc 0.15.3 stops
    # at Python 3.13), so the run environment is unsolvable.
    - enable_openmc == "openmc" and match(python, "3.14.*")
  prefix_detection:
    ignore_binary_files: true

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
    - ${{ compiler("fortran") }}
    - cmake
    - make
    - pkg-config
  host:
    - python
    - setuptools
    - meson-python  # required for f2py in pyne/CMakeLists.txt
    - hdf5
    - numpy
    - pytables
    - cython
    - if: enable_moab == "moab"
      then: moab
  run:
    - python
    - hdf5
    - pytables
    - numpy
    - scipy
    - future
    - jinja2
    - if: enable_moab == "moab"
      then: moab
    - if: enable_openmc == "openmc"
      then: openmc
  run_exports:
    - ${{ pin_subpackage('pyne', upper_bound='x.x') }}

tests:
  - package_contents:
      bin:
        - aceviewer
        - activation_responses.py
        - expand_tags.py
        - gtcadis.py
        - meshtal_to_mesh
        - nuc_data_make
        - ptrac_to_hdf5
        - r2s.py
        - ssw_combine.py
        - tape9
      include:
        - pyne/_atomic_data.h
        - pyne/_decay.h
        - pyne/atomic_data.h
        - pyne/cram.h
        - pyne/cram.hpp
        - pyne/dagmc_bridge.h
        - pyne/data.h
        - pyne/decay.h
        - pyne/enrichment.h
        - pyne/enrichment_cascade.h
        - pyne/enrichment_symbolic.h
        - pyne/extra_types.h
        - pyne/h5wrap.h
        - pyne/json-forwards.h
        - pyne/json.h
        - pyne/jsoncustomwriter.h
        - pyne/material.h
        - pyne/material_library.h
        - pyne/measure.h
        - pyne/nucname.h
        - pyne/particle.h
        - pyne/pyne.h
        - pyne/rxname.h
        - pyne/source.h
        - pyne/source_sampling.h
        - pyne/tally.h
        - pyne/transmuters.h
        - pyne/utils.h
      lib:
        - pyne
      site_packages:
        - pyne
        - pyne.apigen
        - pyne.cli
        - pyne.dbgen
        - pyne.fortranformat
        - pyne.gui
        - pyne/nuc_data.h5

  - python:
      imports:
        - pyne
      pip_check: true
      python_version: ${{ python }}

  - files:
      source:
        - tests
    requirements:
      run:
        # Upstream nose 1.3.7 imports the standard-library `imp` module, which was
        # removed in Python 3.12. pynose is a maintained fork that exposes the same
        # `nose` and `nose.tools` APIs but works on Python 3.12+.
        - pynose
    script:
      - python -c "from pyne.pyne_config import pyne_conf; print(pyne_conf.NUC_DATA_PATH)"
      - cd tests
      # It takes too long to download data files for CI, and several tests
      # require network access that is not available in conda-forge's CI:
      #   - test_endf, test_endl: download ENDF data from www-nds.iaea.org
      #   - test_decay: downloads ORIGEN benchmark from github.com/pyne/data
      #     and also imports `decaygen` from the source `src/` directory,
      #     which is not shipped with the binary package
      #   - test_fortran, test_data_nofile, test_materials_library,
      #     xs/test_data_source: known data-availability failures on CI
      - rm -f test_endf.py test_endl.py test_decay.py xs/test_data_source.py test_fortran.py test_data_nofile.py test_materials_library.py
      # test_material_xrays, test_material_photons, and test_decay_u235_h3
      # use hard-coded reference values that match x86_64 floating-point
      # results down to the last ULP; on aarch64/arm64 the same CRAM-based
      # computation lands ~1 ULP off (and shifts a near-threshold nuclide
      # in/out of the decay output), causing exact-equality assertions to
      # fail. Skip just those three tests on ARM platforms.
      - if: target_platform in ["osx-arm64", "linux-aarch64"]
        then: nosetests --nocapture --exclude='test_material_xrays|test_material_photons|test_decay_u235_h3'
        else: nosetests --nocapture
